name: drupal/data_surface
description: A runtime definition layer between Form API and storage: groups of refinable core data definitions that drive generated forms, validation, and machine-readable contracts.

suggest.drupal/address: Enables the data_surface_address submodule, which describes the address field type's instance settings as a surface.
suggest.drupal/tool: Enables the data_surface_tool submodule, which offers field instance settings to Tool API callers as a described input.
